postal_system.postcode_rule: Posta Kenya currently describes the postcode as a distinct five-digit identifier for an individual post office in a postal region. A current assignment requires a permitted successful operator observation or a release-pinned rights-cleared office table; syntax, the dated UPU coding hierarchy, an address example or a tender row outside its stated scope is insufficient.
postal_system.identifier_split_rule: P.O. Box number, five-digit delivery-post-office code, post-office name, MPost or e-Njiwa virtual address, telephone, NASK address, property identifier and AGID remain typed separately. The string 34567-00100 is a box-number and postcode pair, not a ten-digit postcode, and no resident, box holder, virtual-address owner or physical location is inferred.
postal_system.geometry_rule: No rights-cleared nationwide official postcode catchment polygon release is bundled or identified. Post-office or Posta-property points, postal regions, postcode prefixes, counties, constituencies, wards, localities, NASK proposals, cadastral parcels, buffers, Voronoi cells, routes and learned surfaces are not official postcode polygons; permitted generated surfaces remain derived non-canonical review geometry.
postal_system.address_rule: Posta and UPU publications establish typed address fields and examples, not reusable customer rows. Store recipient or organization, P.O. Box, MPost or e-Njiwa, delivery post office, five-digit postcode, county, locality, street, estate or building, house, floor, room, telephone and NASK address as separate fields with provenance and visibility.
postal_system.building_rule: An exact building or parcel may be returned only from an exact rights-cleared artifact with a stable explicit NASK-or-authoritative-civic-address-to-building or cadastral relation. Postcode, P.O. Box, MPost, address text, post-office proximity, coordinate containment, polygon overlap, nearest feature and model score are candidates only.
postal_system.licence_rule: Posta pages and publications, UPU database rights, Communications Authority and Ministry policy documents, Survey of Kenya maps, Ardhisasa records and open-data artifacts retain source-specific copyright, access, privacy and redistribution terms. Every artifact needs exact owner, licence, version, access class and digests; OSM stays in a separate attributed ODbL partition.
postal_system.privacy_rule: Kenya ODPC guidance treats physical and postal address and location as personal data and property details as sensitive personal data. Customer, P.O. Box, MPost, telephone, precise address, household, parcel, title, owner, resident, delivery and query-log data require lawful purpose, minimisation, access control, retention, data-subject and publication review.
postal_system.hosting_rule: Cloudflare and Hugging Face may host only rights-cleared immutable artifacts pinned to releases or Hub commits with verified digests. Customer, box-holder, virtual-address, telephone, household, parcel, title, owner, query-log, credential and access-controlled material remains gated or external.
postal_system.agid_rule: AGID remains an independent spatial index. Versioned crosswalks may relate permitted postcode, post office, P.O. Box service, NASK, civic address, administrative, building and derived review objects to AGID cells without relabelling an AGID cell as canonical Kenyan postal or administrative geometry.
